name: GEdit-Bench
intro: GEdit-Bench 从超过 1,000 个真实互联网图像编辑实例筛选并去标识化 606 组图像与请求，每组配一条英文和一条中文指令，在固定数据版本中形成 1,212 行。评测先区分每种语言最多 606 例的完整视图和所有参评模型都有有效输出的英文 434/中文 422 交集，再用 VIEScore 评分并按 11 类的非加权均值汇总。
build_method: 真实用户实例收集, 11 类人工筛选, 反向搜图去标识化, 中英双语配对
metric: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 完整集与共同有效交集分开报告, VIEScore 双 VLM 评委, 分数组解析回退, 11 类宏平均
scale: 606 组双语实例（1,212 行）、11 个类别
build_method_en: Real-user Collection, Manual 11-category Filtering, Reverse-search De-identification, Paired EN/ZH Instructions
eval_feature_en: Separate Full/Common-valid Views, Dual-VLM VIEScore, Score-parser Fallback, Unweighted 11-category Macro Mean
intro_en: GEdit-Bench filters and de-identifies 606 image-request pairs from more than 1,000 real Internet editing cases, then adds one English and one Chinese instruction per pair, yielding 1,212 rows in the pinned dataset. Evaluation separates the up-to-606 full view per language from common valid-output intersections of 434 English and 422 Chinese cases, applies VIEScore, and averages the 11 category means without weighting.
metric_en: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against Step1X-Edit arXiv:2504.17761v5, official repository commit 4cca05dfcd6c32dc810d0b4db84c2bf0682a5aeb, and stepfun-ai/GEdit-Bench dataset revision 50766778e2a737474c7e9bdf84cdce82c3ea3f4f. Construction starts from more than 1,000 real Internet editing cases, manually assigns 11 categories, filters same-purpose instructions, and retains 606 pairs. User images are reverse-searched across public engines and replaced with visually and semantically consistent public images; when no substitute exists, instructions are modified while preserving the anonymized image-instruction intent. Each pair receives one English and one Chinese instruction. The pinned dataset has 1,212 rows and fields task_type, key, instruction, instruction_language, input_image, input_image_raw, and Intersection_exist. The common valid-output flag totals 434 English and 422 Chinese rows; those intersections depend on the paper's tested model panel. The fixed evaluator skips missing edited-output files, so full-view means exclude failed or missing outputs rather than dividing by all 606. VIEScore judges original image, edited image, and instruction in tie mode. Paper v5 is internally inconsistent: Figure 7 and one evaluation-prose sentence name GPT-4o, while Section 4.2.1 and Tables 2-3 name GPT-4.1; the pinned evaluator uses GPT-4.1 with Qwen2.5-VL-72B. It parses 0-10 SC/PQ arrays, retries once then falls back or guesses, takes each array minimum, computes O=sqrt(SC*PQ), averages within each category, and reports the unweighted mean of the 11 category means for full and common subsets.
